basic_info.description: Welcome to Noe & Valley an expansive and thoughtfully remodeled 1-bedroom, 1-bath residence featuring exclusive attached garage parking. This home boasts direct access from the street, a bright & inviting living room lit by a large arched window. The generously sized kitchen offers ample room for an eat-in table, stainless steel appliances, a breakfast bar, butcher block countertops, and windows on three sides, creating a bright and inviting space perfect for cooking and dining.  The layout of the rear room can be tailored to your lifestyle needs whether as a dining or family room with south-facing views. Step outside onto the private deck to enjoy views of Diamond and Bernal Heights.  Both the bedroom and bathroom have been tastefully updated blending modern comfort with warmth & style. Upstairs, the bonus room accessible via stairs offers versatile space with skylights and multiple windows, ideal for a second bedroom, office, or hobby room.   Additional features include central AC, and smart appliances.  Located steps from the Sanchez slow street, MUNI rail, and vibrant shopping and dining along Church St and 24th St, this home enjoys a Walk Score of 91 and provides quick access to highways 101 & 280.  This residence perfectly balances urban convenience with comfortable living.
